parameters.content:
StartCollaborativeBuild
  ├─ Generate sessionId
  ├─ Save to DB
  └─ Execute: SpawnWorkers (pass taskDivision too)
      ↓
SpawnWorkers
  ├─ Spawn workers (workerCount: 3)
  ├─ Append to spawnedWorkers array
  └─ Execute: WaitAndRegister (pass taskDivision)
      ↓
WaitAndRegister
  ├─ Wait for workers ready
  ├─ Register workers
  └─ Execute: CoordinateBuild (pass taskDivision)
      ↓
CoordinateBuild
  ├─ Create session
  ├─ Get position
  ├─ Reserve location
  ├─ Teleport workers
  └─ Execute: DistributeTasks (pass taskDivision) ← HERE!
      ↓
DistributeTasks
  ├─ Function: Convert taskDivision to array
  ├─ Loop through tasks
  ├─ HTTP POST send-task to each worker
  └─ Complete
